note: H8, the existence test. Hands 25% of animal founders a ready-made carnivore genotype (carnivory 0.85, herbivory 0.15, meatAttraction 0.60, biteForce 2.0) via v0.55's invasion probe [L0.55-1]. Rationale: three structural attempts at making carnivory emerge have now missed -- v0.52 fixed the payoff, v0.53 removed the oscillation, v0.54 replaced the argmax arbiter -- and in every one meatAttraction stayed at its founder value while herbivory and biteForce moved 10-25x further. From the herbivore corner an unreachable peak and an absent peak look identical. This does not make carnivores evolve; it asks whether a carnivore handed the genotype can make a living. If they are purged, no landscape-crossing mechanism is worth building and the far peak has to be constructed before it can be reached.
